_doc: Book questions the coordinate parser cannot recover, transcribed BY EYE from the rendered pages of docs/Radiokomunikacije_ocr.pdf. The answer still comes from the book's own key table (book_keys.json) — only the question text and the option ORDER are supplied here, since the key is read by position a/b/c/d. Page numbers are PDF pages; the printed page is 5 higher.

_reasons.merged-block: Two questions ran together into one block because neither carried an OCR'd number, so the parser could not see the boundary.
_reasons.stacked-options: All four options are set in a single full-width column rather than two, which the column logic reads as stem continuation.
_reasons.figure-options: The options ARE diagrams; there is no option text in the source at all.
_reasons.cross-reference: The options are bare letters referring to the figure of an earlier question.
